input.summary: Replace the Section 6.1 Company exclusivity covenant (and HDI's exclusive Deerskin brand right) with a clause-level no-restriction statement
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot restrict the products we sell or the Internet projects we run, so we have replaced Section 6.1 — which for the whole auto-renewing term barred the Company from any similar project involving Deerskin Products or "substantially similar" products and gave HDI the exclusive right to our own "Deerskin" brand — with an express statement that this exclusivity article imposes no such restriction. HDI's covenant in Section 6.3, the Company's retained closeout rights in Section 6.2 and the Section 9(b) Globix proviso are unaffected; if HDI needs protection we could discuss a 12-month restriction on a single named competing product with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.

ops.oldText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: 6.1 Nothing in this Section 6 restricts the products the Company may offer, the projects in which the Company may participate, or the Company's use or licensing of the "Deerskin" brand.
